convert_hf_model_to_gguf: convert a huggingface model directory to GGUF format with specified output type like f16 or q8_0
export_model_vocab_only: export only the tokenizer vocabulary from a huggingface model directory to a GGUF vocab file
export_mmproj_for_vision_model: export the multimodal projector weights from a vision-language model to GGUF format
print_supported_models: print the list of all supported model architectures for HF-to-GGUF conversion
convert_remote_hf_model: convert a huggingface model repository from remote using its model ID without downloading locally
